hypothesis: Cross-stream, lagged learned normal relationships can flag physical inconsistencies missed by message-only detection.
inputs: IPAL records with timestamp, src, dest and data; explicit physically justified stream and field mapping is mandatory.
development: Chronological first 70% of aligned normal-only pairs used to fit least-squares linear mapping; remaining 30% calibrate a 1% residual threshold. No attack labels used until frozen model is stored.
test: Separate attack capture scored once against unchanged frozen calibration; per-target message label is recorded separately from reference-stream attack context.
passes: Not defined until real target mapping and independent ground truth are reviewed; current proof is a deterministic synthetic unit demonstration, not a claim of attack detection.
limits: If no validated mapping or insufficient correlation/normal variation, fail closed. Missing reference data is INDETERMINATE, not benign. Correlation does not establish causal physical relationship.
